answer: Because stake is slashed on collusion detection and the vertex history is public, creating N sybils costs N times the bond plus forfeited history, making mass identity farming economically irrational. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked at a registered vertex in the reputation graph, and any newcomer who tries to wander in as many fake identities must post the same stake per identity. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
